title: Loading a 3D Tiles Tileset (Helmets)
description: Loads a 3D Tiles tileset.json with ThreeDTilesLoader: a 2x2 grid of four tiles, each referencing the same Y-up glTF model placed by the tile's transform. The loader fetches each tile's content relative to baseUri, applies the Y-up to Z-up rotation, and bakes each tile transform into the per-mesh matrices of one SceneModel.
